title: LinkedIn Company Hiring Tracker Input
description: Paste LinkedIn company URLs. The actor returns one hiring signal row per company, with a change figure when run on a schedule.

companyUrls.title: Company URLs or numeric IDs
companyUrls.description: LinkedIn company page URLs, or raw numeric organization IDs. Examples: 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe/', 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/anthropicresearch/', '74126343'.

maxRolesScanPerCompany.title: Max roles to scan per company
maxRolesScanPerCompany.description: Pagination cap. The actor walks the company's public job list 25 at a time up to this many roles, then reports the total it counted. Raise it for very large employers.

roleKeyword.title: Restrict to roles matching
roleKeyword.description: Optional. Only count roles whose title contains this text, for example 'engineer' or 'sales'. Leave blank to count every open role.

trackDeltas.title: Track change since last run
trackDeltas.description: Store each company's count between runs so a scheduled run reports the change versus the previous run. The hiring velocity is the whole point of this actor.

topLocations.title: Top locations to include
topLocations.description: How many of the busiest hiring locations to include in the per company breakdown.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. The public jobs endpoint is light, but residential improves reliability at volume.
